summary: EXPLORERS OF SPACE is a story-driven planetary exploration game inspired by NASA's historic missions to the Moon and Mars. It aims to turn abandoned spacecraft, landers, rovers, and scientific instruments into interactive discoveries that help players understand the engineering, mission history, and science behind space exploration. The prototype introduces a cinematic lunar environment, while the broader concept combines exploration, historical information, investigation, and a fictional mystery grounded in real mission history. Its goal is to make the legacy of space exploration engaging and memorable for young learners.
details:
Overview

AFTERLIGHT: FORGOTTEN WORLDS is a proposed story-driven exploration game developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 challenge, “Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars.”

The project explores how historical space hardware can become a way to teach young audiences about planetary exploration, engineering, and scientific discovery.

Problem

Space missions leave behind landers, instruments, descent stages, rovers, and other equipment. These objects represent important engineering achievements and scientific history, but their stories can be difficult for young audiences to experience through static information alone.

Proposed solution

The project proposes an immersive exploration experience in which players investigate lunar and Martian environments, discover historic mission equipment, learn about its original purpose, and connect discoveries through a fictional mystery.

The intended full experience includes planetary navigation, distinct exploration regions, astronaut movement, interactive historical information, an evidence journal, environmental puzzles, and consequential story choices.

Current implementation

The current prototype provides a lunar exploration environment where players can move around and view three objects. It is an early proof of concept, and the full level system, detailed interactive information panels, and complete story progression are not yet verified as implemented.

Intended impact

The project aims to make space history more engaging for young learners by connecting real mission hardware to the science it enabled and the challenges engineers faced.

Tools

Astrocade was used to create the game prototype. AI assistance was used for concept development, narrative planning, and presentation preparation. The specific contributions of each tool are disclosed in the AI-use section.
